name: bioinfo-bench
description: bioinfo-bench is a collection of bioinformatics-focused tasks intended to evaluate machine learning models on common problems in computational biology (for example sequence classification, motif detection, or other domain-specific prediction tasks). The benchmark measures predictive performance across biological sequence or feature datasets and is intended to compare models' accuracy and generalization in bioinformatics settings. It is aimed at assessing model applicability to real-world biological data rather than language-only benchmarks.
reputation: A niche dataset on Hugging Face with limited but growing adoption within specialized bioinformatics ML experiments.
